[[File:DagobahMushroomSpore-TVE.png|thumb|right|250px|Mushroom spores]]
'''Mushrooms''' were [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] found on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. The [[Emperor's skyhook]] featured a manicured jungle that emitted a fine odor smelling of mushrooms.

While in self-imposed exile on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] made mushroom spores a part of his diet.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

Huge [[Color/Legends|pink]] mushrooms with a meaty scent grew in dense [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Kato Zakar]] continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>

==Mushroom types==
*[[Vaporator mushroom/Legends|Vaporator mushroom]], mushrooms that grew on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]
*[[Macaab mushroom]]s, mushrooms that grew on [[Arzid]]
*[[Fantazi mushroom]]s, mushrooms that grew on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]
*[[Balo mushroom/Legends|Balo mushrooms]], mushrooms that grew on [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]]
*[[Cattarash mushroom]]s, mushrooms that grew on [[Gandle Ott]]
*[[Snoruuk/Legends|Snoruuks]], mobile mushrooms that grew on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]
*[[Luilris mushroom]]s, mushrooms that grew in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]
